passive.name: Triumphant Roar
passive.description: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.

primaryAbilities.name: Pulverize
primaryAbilities.description: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Alistar smashes the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for {{ knockupduration }} second and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Headbutt
primaryAbilities.description: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Alistar rams into an enemy, <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Back</status> and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Trample
primaryAbilities.description: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Alistar begins trampling the ground, becoming Ghosted and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ duration }} seconds to nearby enemies. Each pulse that damages a champion grants a stack.

At {{ maxstacks }} stacks, Alistar's next Attack against champions Stuns for {{ stunduration }} second and deals an additional {{ attackbonusdamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Unbreakable Will
primaryAbilities.description: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Alistar immediately cleanses all <status>Disabling</status> effects and takes {{ rdamagereduction }}% reduced damage for {{ rduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Triumphant Roar
allSpellRecords.summary: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Alistar gains a stack whenever he Stuns or Knocks an enemy champion, or whenever an enemy dies. At [7] stacks, Alistar roars, restoring [(0.05) × Stat(12)] Health to himself and [((0.05) × Stat(12)) × (1.4)] Health to nearby allied champions.

Enemy champion and epic jungle monster deaths fully charge this Ability.

allSpellRecords.name: Unbreakable Will
allSpellRecords.summary: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Alistar immediately cleanses all Disabling effects and takes [55 / 65 / 75]% reduced damage for [7] seconds.

allSpellRecords.name: Trample
allSpellRecords.summary: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Alistar begins trampling the ground, becoming Ghosted and dealing [80 / 110 / 140 / 170 / 200 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage over [5] seconds to nearby enemies. Each pulse that damages a champion grants a stack.

At [5] stacks, Alistar's next Attack against champions Stuns for [1] second and deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=15, changes=[])] magic damage.

allSpellRecords.name: Pulverize
allSpellRecords.summary: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Alistar smashes the ground, Knocking Up enemies for [1] second and dealing [60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

allSpellRecords.name: Headbutt
allSpellRecords.summary: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Alistar rams into an enemy, Knocking them Back and dealing [55 / 110 / 165 / 220 / 275 + (1) × AP] magic damage.
